title: FCM registration token does not fit PushSubscription.url model
description: The intro states the server uses PushSubscription.url (RFC 8620) as the delivery endpoint. FCM breaks this: there is no per-device URL. The guide says store the registration token but never explains how a JMAP server using RFC 8620 PushSubscription accommodates this. Does the token go in a custom extension property? In a synthetic URL? Does the server need a non-standard PushSubscription extension? This is a real architectural question implementers will hit immediately and the guide needs to address it.
close_reason: Resolved: FCM/APNs reframed as out-of-band server-side backends; PushSubscription.url is Web Push only
